# Alpha Empire Logistics

Alpha Empire Logistics is a South African logistics company providing cross-border logistics, procurement, engineering support, fleet solutions, and mining & construction support across Southern and Central Africa, primarily the South Africa — DRC corridor.

## Company
- Primary brand: Alpha Empire Logistics (South Africa)
- DRC operations arm: Alpha Empire Corp SARLU
- Founded: 2016
- Founder: Alpha Balebela-Maiba

## Services
- Cross-Border Logistics: SA-DRC freight, customs clearance, cross-border compliance
- Procurement & Industrial Supply: Mining equipment, spare parts, industrial consumables
- Engineering & Technical Support: Heavy civil, mechanical, industrial project teams
- Fleet & Equipment Solutions: Heavy haulage, equipment leasing, oversized cargo
- Mining & Construction Support: Site logistics, fuel, consumables, site services

## Industries Served
Mining, Construction, Infrastructure, Industrial Operations, Energy, Procurement & Supply Chain, Logistics & Transport
